dz: 在瑞典斯德哥尔摩上空观察到了复杂的光环显示,激发了"太阳犬"("The Sundog paint"),最早描绘了这样的事件,最古老地描绘了这座城市.
de: A complex halo display is observed over Stockholm, Sweden, inspiring the Vädersolstavlan ("The Sundog painting"), the earliest depiction of such an event, and the oldest colour depiction of the city.

dz: 法国探险家雅克·卡蒂埃(Jacques Cartier)在第二次出海到北美时与三艘船一起出航,110人出航,而多纳科纳酋长的两个儿子(卡蒂埃在第一次出航时曾被他绑架)出航.
de: French explorer Jacques Cartier sets sail on his second voyage to North America with three ships, 110 men, and Chief Donnacona's two sons (whom Cartier had kidnapped during his first voyage).

t: 与教宗公牛"艾乌斯"(Eius qui imimmobilations)一起,教宗保禄三世将英…
te: With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Churc…
dz: 与教宗公牛"艾乌斯"(Eius qui imimmobilations)一起,教宗保禄三世将英格兰国王亨利八世从天主教会中驱逐出,因为批准"苏普雷米西"法案,虽然公牛很可能从未出版.
de: With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Church for approving the Acts of Supremacy, although the bull is likely never published.
